prs.title: chore(deps): bump hono from 4.12.9 to 4.12.12
prs.author: app/dependabot
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Hono framework ecosystem update: `hono` (core) and `@hono/node-server` (Node.js adapter) are companion packages published by the same team and released in coordination. `@hono/node-server` has a peer dependency on `hono`, so both must be bumped together to guarantee runtime compatibility. Keeping them as separate PRs risks a window where one is merged without the other. (2 PRs)
